title: Digital education center to boost Sino-African ties
notes: State-media report of the center launch with quotes from the institutions involved; defensible as a record of the event. Cited for the Kenya digital education center under Social (Global South).
claims: First Regional Cooperation Center for China-Africa Digital Education launched at the Open University of Kenya (Machakos) on Feb 7, 2025, plus an Open Learning Center
Part of plans announced at the 2024 FOCAC Summit
Collaboration between Open University of China, Donghua University, and Open University of Kenya
Focus: staff capacity-building, academic/nonacademic programs, co-offered programs; five-year horizon
